title: TimpaTeks: Automatic In-place Text Sequence Modification via Diffusion Language Model Steering
abstract: arXiv:2606.08408v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We extend activation steering to diffusion language models (DLMs) and study a novel problem that arose due to the inference mechanism of DLMs: Modifying a text in-place to manifest a different concept. We propose TimpaTeks, an automatic in-place text modification mechanism using DLMs. Experiments on IMDB movie reviews (sentiment) and a synthetic Cats and Dogs Dataset (arbitrary, more unconventional concept steering) show that TimpaTeks provides a feasible novel mechanism to steer diffusion language model outputs in-place. TimpaTeks enables in-place modification while simultaneously lowers sentence perplexity and retaining the original sentence structre without the need of instruction tuned models. TimpaTeks is also computationally cheaper than prompt-based DLM steering, as it performs denoising in-place rather than constructing an additional prompt-conditioned output sequence.

translated_title: TimpaTeks：基于扩散语言模型引导的自动原地文本序列修改
translated_abstract: 我们将激活引导技术扩展到扩散语言模型，并研究了由扩散语言模型推理机制所引发的一个新问题：对文本进行原地修改以呈现不同的概念。我们提出了TimpaTeks，一种使用扩散语言模型的自动原地文本修改机制。在IMDB电影评论（情感概念）和一个合成的猫狗数据集（任意的、更非传统的概念引导）上的实验表明，TimpaTeks提供了一种可行的新型机制来原地引导扩散语言模型的输出。TimpaTeks无需依赖指令微调模型即可实现原地修改，同时能够降低句子困惑度并保留原始句子结构。此外，由于TimpaTeks执行的是原地去噪而非构建额外的提示条件输出序列，其计算成本也低于基于提示的扩散语言模型引导方法。
tldr: TimpaTeks将激活引导扩展到扩散语言模型，实现了一种无需指令微调模型的自动原地文本修改机制，在保留原句结构、降低困惑度的同时，以更低的计算成本改变文本所表达的概念。
en_tdlr: TimpaTeks extends activation steering to diffusion language models, enabling automatic in-place text modification that alters text concepts with lower computational cost, reduced perplexity, and preserved sentence structure, all without requiring instruction-tuned models.
